	title = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_event_1534_title
	desc = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_event_1534_desc
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = SOV
		CYP = {
			exists = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_SOV_p4_finance_a
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_live_SOV_p4_finance_a
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_offer_instance_p4_finance_a = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_crisis_instance }
			original_tag = CYP
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
			country_exists = SOV
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_p4_finance_review
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_p4_finance_review }
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_p4_finance_review
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_event_1534_option_382
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_CYP_1970.3234
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = CYP
		IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_registered_tc_kucuk
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_community_pending_tc_kucuk
	}
	immediate = {
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_community_pending_tc_kucuk
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = CYP
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_leadership
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_pending_completion_tc_leadership }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_applied_tc_leadership
					}
				}
				always = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_grant_tc_kucuk = yes

			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CYP_1970.5234 days = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_terms_rejected
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_declined_tc_kucuk
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CYP_1970.6234 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_settlement_progress value = 90 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_1970_communal_tension > 15 } }
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_guarantees_revised
			}
			COLDWAR_CYP_1970_grant_tc_enosis_consent = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_enosis_assent
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CYP_1970.5263 days = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_tc_terms_rejected
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_declined_tc_enosis_consent
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CYP_1970.6263 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}
